links.outcome: Postoperative AKI incidence across phased rollout of CDS tools at 26 sites
links.effect: PO-AKI fell from a baseline average of 1,031 cases per month to 400 per month after full Phase 3 implementation; intraoperative hypotension episodes fell 33% in Phase 1.
links.quote: With the full implementation of risk tools, alerts, and order sets in Phase 3, AKI incidence declined to 400 cases per month.

unlisted_practices: Improvement-science-guided implementation of EHR-integrated clinical decision support (risk stratification, alerts, order sets with care bundles) to reduce postoperative AKI

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world regional deployment across 26 hospitals of an EHR-integrated clinical decision support system combining predictive risk assessment tools with clinical alerts and care bundles to prevent postoperative AKI.

primary.practice: EHR-integrated CDS alerts and risk-stratified order sets
